text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Nooo, Isami-chan!? Your lips are quivering 
violently!?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
He-heheh... I just couldn't sleep, that's 
all! I've got a presentation for the 
academy's higher-ups coming up♪

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
If it's for the "Beauty Dream Cup," 
there's no challenge I can't... 
Hauwahwahwah!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I-Isami-chan!? ...Oh no. Her emotions are 
exploding from the nerves. In times like 
this—

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Isami-chan! Your main symptoms are lack of 
sleep, and extreme nervousness! In that 
case, this technique will do the trick!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Did it work?! Did it do the trick?! Behold 
my "Super Secret Pressure Point ☆ May 
Everything Work Out ☆ Qigong Attack"!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: So it's all right now, Isami-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You'll definitely nail the presentation. 
No matter what job comes your way, you can 
overcome it.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...After all, she's my cute little sister.

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...Big sis, your treatments are the best 
in the world♪ Hehe, my body's starting to 
feel so light!
